errors.text_span: declines to roughly 20.65 at x=0.7, remains steady until x=0.9
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly describes the 'FT' line. The data point at x=0.7 is not clearly visible and appears to be an artifact or an error in reading the chart. Based on the visible data points and the line connecting them, the line declines from x=0.3 (y≈22.0) to a point obscured by the legend (around x=0.5, y≈20.7), and then continues to a visible point at x=0.9 (y≈20.7). The description of a point at x=0.7 is a hallucination or misinterpretation of the obscured visual data.
The y-axis label in the figure uses a left arrow (←), not a down arrow (↓), to indicate that lower values are better. While the meaning is similar, the symbol is different.
